librarygames/asteroids/Rocks.xtl

Asteroids' rules, a library: asteroids.xtl (scripted), play.xtl (the game: keys and the clock) and the web page all use these. Built on lib/Ecs: a world is a matrix, a row per entity slot, and every rule is a system over every entity at once. The entities come and go all the time: every shot is spawned and spent, every rock hit is despawned and its two halves spawned in the slots that freed. Which slots hold what is only masks (alive, rock, shot), so the churn needs no lists kept. A game's state is a tuple: (the world, the score, the lives left, the wave, the seconds played, how it stands: 0 playing, 1 every wave cleared, 2 no lives left, the seconds the ship cannot be hit).

source · imports ec: lib/Ecs.xtl lib/Ecs.xtlm; sv: lib/Svg.xtl

The data

ʰw̲orld : Int -> Float

function (private) · line 20

The layout: where it is (x then y, in tiles, y down), how fast it moves, the ship's heading (radians, 0 to the right), a rock's size (1 small to 3 big), a shot's time left, and what it is.

"h" ᵉᶜc̲omponents< "pos:2 vel:2 dir size life ship rock shot"
ᵉᶜc̲omponents< expands to
ʰw̲orld ← { n → (n c̲at 19) r̲eshape 0.0 }
ʰp̲os ← { W → (3 4) s̲elect₂ W }
ʰh̲asPos ← { W → 0 < 2 s̲elect₂ W }
ʰs̲etPos ← { W (ids, v) →
  i ← r̲avel ids
  V ← (((t̲ally i) c̲at 1) r̲eshape 1.0) c̲at₂ ((t̲ally i) c̲at 2) r̲eshape v
  R ← f̲loat (r̲ange t̲ally W) '= t̲able i
  C ← f̲loat (2 3 4) '= t̲able r̲ange 19
  M ← 0 < R '+ '× i̲nner (((t̲ally i) c̲at 3) r̲eshape 1.0) '+ '× i̲nner C
  (W × f̲loat n̲ot M) + R '+ '× i̲nner V '+ '× i̲nner C
}
ʰd̲ropPos ← { W ids → W × f̲loat n̲ot ((r̲ange t̲ally W) m̲ember? r̲avel ids) '× t̲able 2 = r̲ange 19 }
ʰv̲el ← { W → (6 7) s̲elect₂ W }

ʰw̲ave : Float -> Int -> Float

function (private) · line 50

A wave of big rocks (wave k says how many): each on a ring around the middle, flying off in a direction of its own, all drawn at random.

ʰw̲ave ← { W k →
  n ← k s̲elect WAVES
  (W, ids) ← W ᵉᶜs̲pawn n
  a ← ʰr̲adians r̲oll! n r̲eshape 360
  b ← ʰr̲adians r̲oll! n r̲eshape 360
  W ← W ʰs̲etPos (ids, ʰp̲air ((0.5 × FX) + 7.0 × c̲os a, (0.5 × FY) + 7.0 × s̲in a))
  W ← W ʰs̲etVel (ids, ʰp̲air ((3 s̲elect SPEEDS) × c̲os b, (3 s̲elect SPEEDS) × s̲in b))
  W ← W ʰs̲etSize (ids, 3.0)
  W ʰs̲etRock (ids, 1.0)
}
Used in: ˡn̲ew, ʰn̲ext
